brand.name: Brim Burgers
brand.about: Smash burgers, fries, hot dogs, wraps and shakes across Pakistan. Prices in PKR.
brand.opening_hours: Lahore branches 12:00 PM - 2:30 AM, Islamabad branches 11:00 AM - 1:45 AM. See each branch for exact hours.

ordering.how_to_order: Delivery or Pick-Up, online at brimburgers.blinkco.io or via the Android/iPhone app; phone orders on 042 111 222 746.
ordering.advance_payment: Any order above Rs 10,000 requires 50% payment in advance.
ordering.delivery_fee: Usually Rs 100 (Rs 150 in some Bahria Town / Lake City areas and in Sargodha).
ordering.delivery_time: Up to about 45 minutes (about 60 minutes in Sargodha and parts of Bahria Town).
ordering.payment_methods: Cash on delivery or online payment.
